name: jupyter-repl
author: lumine-code
description: Run code interactively with Jupyter kernels.
backgroundTips: You can run the line or the selection under the cursor in a Jupyter kernel with {{ 'jupyter-repl:run' | keystroke }}
You can run the whole cell around the cursor with {{ 'jupyter-repl:run-cell' | keystroke }}

autocomplete.title: Enable autocomplete
autocomplete.description: If enabled, use autocomplete options provided by the current kernel. This applies to the main editor and the expression editors other jupyter packages watch through this service.

showInspectorResultsInAutocomplete.title: Enable autocomplete description
showInspectorResultsInAutocomplete.description: If enabled, jupyter-repl will try to show the results from kernel inspection in each autocomplete suggestion's description. May slow down the autocompletion performance. **Note**: Even if you disable this, you would still get autocomplete suggestions.

autocompleteSuggestionPriority.title: Autocomplete suggestion priority
autocompleteSuggestionPriority.description: Autocomplete suggestion priority. Lower value means higher priority relative to other providers. The built-in snippets provider has priority 2.

importNotebookURI.title: Enable notebook auto-import
importNotebookURI.description: If enabled, opening a file with extension `.ipynb` will import the notebook file's source into a new tab. If disabled, or if the jupyter-repl package is not activated, the raw file will open in Lumine as normal.

importNotebookResults.title: Enable import of notebook results
importNotebookResults.description: If enabled, anytime you import a notebook, the saved results are also rendered inline. If disabled, you can still import notebooks as normal.

statusBarDisable.title: Disable the jupyter-repl status bar
statusBarDisable.description: If enabled, no kernel information will be provided in Lumine's status bar.

statusBarKernelInfo.title: Detailed kernel information in the jupyter-repl status bar
statusBarKernelInfo.description: If enabled, more detailed kernel information (execution count, execution time if available) will be shown in the jupyter-repl status bar. This requires the above **Disable the jupyter-repl status bar** setting to be `false` to work.

autoKernelPicker.title: Auto kernel picker
autoKernelPicker.description: Automatically select kernel if only one available.

globalMode.title: Enable global kernel
globalMode.description: If enabled, all files of the same grammar will share a single global kernel (requires Lumine restart).

startDir.title: Directory to start kernel in
startDir.description: Restart the kernel for changes to take effect.

enum.description: The project directory relative to the file

kernelNotifications.title: Enable kernel notifications
kernelNotifications.description: Notify if kernels writes to stdout. By default, kernel notifications are only displayed in the developer console.

cellMarkers.title: Create cell markers
cellMarkers.description: The cell marker decoration can be customised in your `styles.css`. Requires reopening the editor after config change.

autoScroll.title: Enable autoscroll
autoScroll.description: If enabled, jupyter-repl will automatically scroll to the bottom of the result view.

scrollOnMoveDown.title: Scroll behavior on move down
scrollOnMoveDown.description: Controls scrolling behavior when running code and moving to the next line.

enum.description: Don't scroll - cursor moves but view stays
Center scroll - always center cursor on screen
Scroll until half window - scroll only when cursor passes mid-screen

wrapOutput.title: Enable soft wrap for output
wrapOutput.description: If enabled, your output code from jupyter-repl will break long text and items.

outputAreaDefault.title: View output in the dock by default
outputAreaDefault.description: If enabled, output will be displayed in the dock by default rather than inline.

outputAreaDock.title: Leave output dock open
outputAreaDock.description: Do not close dock when switching to an editor without a running kernel.

outputAreaFontSize.title: Output area fontsize
outputAreaFontSize.description: Change the fontsize of the Output area.

outputMaxLength.title: Maximum output length
outputMaxLength.description: Maximum number of characters to display in output before truncating. Set to 0 for no limit. Large outputs may cause performance issues.

languageMappings.title: Language mappings
languageMappings.description: Custom Lumine grammars and some kernels use non-standard language names. That leaves jupyter-repl unable to figure out what kernel to start for your code. This field should be a valid JSON mapping from a kernel language name to Lumine's grammar name ``` { "kernel name": "grammar name" } ```. For example ``` { "scala211": "scala", "javascript": "babel es6 javascript", "python": "magicpython" } ```.

startupCodePerLanguage.title: Startup code per language
startupCodePerLanguage.description: Code executed on kernel startup, matched by language name. Runs before kernel-specific code. Format: `{"language": "your code \nmore code"}`. Example: `{"python": "%matplotlib inline", "javascript": "console.log('ready')"}`.

startupCodePerKernel.title: Startup code per kernel
startupCodePerKernel.description: Code executed on kernel startup, matched by kernel display name. Format: `{"kernel": "your code \nmore code"}`. Example: `{"Python 3": "%matplotlib inline"}`.

pythonAutoreload.title: Python autoreload
pythonAutoreload.description: Automatically reload modified Python modules before executing code. Useful during development to avoid kernel restarts.

pythonAutoreloadPrint.title: Python autoreload logging
pythonAutoreloadPrint.description: Show messages when modules are reloaded by the autoreload extension.

debug.title: Enable debug messages
debug.description: If enabled, log debug messages onto the dev console.

jupyterCommand.title: Jupyter console command
jupyterCommand.description: Command used by `Launch Jupyter Console` and `Copy Jupyter Console Command`. Use `{python}` for the active kernel's Python interpreter (so the console connects without activating the environment) and `{connection-file}` for the kernel's connection file path (it will be quoted automatically).
